newsitem.title: USA: Presumed U.S. cultist commits suicide -police.
newsitem.headline: Presumed U.S. cultist commits suicide -police.

text.p: A man believed to be a member of the Heaven's Gate cult committed suicide in San Diego, California, on Tuesday, more than a month after 39 cult members died in a strange mass suicide ritual, police said.
Another man believed to be a cult member also tried to kill himself but was still alive and was being treated, the police said.
The identities of the two presumed cult members were not immediately known and neither was the suicide method.
The bodies of the original Heaven's Gate members were found March 26 in an exclusive home in the Rancho Santa Fe district.

The 21 women and 18 men were between the ages of 20 and 72 and were dressed in similar outfits, almost as if they were wearing uniforms. Police said the victims believed they would join up with a UFO behind the Hale-Bopp comet.
They died by eating drug-laced pudding or applesauce washed down with vodka and then placing plastic bags over their heads.
CNN television reported on Tuesday that it had received a videotape from the two men in which one of them said he hoped they had not "missed the bus," CNN said.
